title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - AssociationSpecification
description: AssociationSpecification is an association class that describes a type of relationship between two entities. This is a generic construct that may be used to describe relationship types and roles. The role and type of each entity in the relationship is given by an association role specification. Two role specifications are embedded in the association specification. (TM Forum TMF662 Entity Catalog Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition AssociationSpecification; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:AssociationSpecification:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AssociationSpecification'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/lastUpdate'. The last modified date of this specification

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Indicates the current lifecycle status

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/name'. Name given to this association specification

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/validFor'. The period for which this specification is valid

constraint.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/constraint'. Constraints relating to this association

associationRoleSpec.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/associationRoleSpec'. Role specifications for this association

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:AssociationSpecification:<tmfId>. unique identifier

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF662_EntityCatalog/blob/v4.0.0/TMF662-EntityCatalog-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AssociationSpecification/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'AssociationSpecification' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name

AssociationRoleSpecification.description: This embedded object represents the role and type of each entity involved in a relationship.

aggregation.description: A flag indicates that if this role is an aggregation or a simple relationship

defaultQuantity.description: Default quantity of the association role

entityType.description: The target (root) entity type associated with this role

isNavigable.description: A flag indicating if access from the other end of association is allowed or not

isSource.description: A flag indicating if the participant involved in a uni-directional relationship is the source or not. This flag is true If the association is bi-directional

maxQuantity.description: Maximum allowed quantity of the association role

minQuantity.description: Minimum allowed quantity of the association role

role.description: The association role of this relationship participant

ConstraintRef.description: Constraint reference. The Constraint resource represents a policy/rule applied to an entity or entity spec.

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
